## 5. Definition of Done (DoD)

Before marking this ticket as complete, verify that every item below is fulfilled:

- [ ] Deliverable file exists at the specified target path or link.
- [ ] Content adheres to project guidelines (no inline styles, strict types, or academic paper standards).
- [ ] If code or views were modified: `php tests/runner.php` and `php -l` pass with 0 errors.
- [ ] Work is demonstrated or reviewed with a peer reviewer or the Project Lead.
- [ ] Status updated in `docs/TEAM-TASK-QUEUE.md` and announced in the team Messenger group chat.

---

## 6. Onboarding & Collaboration Reference

- **Handbook**: Consult [Team Onboarding Guide](../../docs/TEAM-ONBOARDING-GUIDE.md) for branch naming, atomic commit standards, and the Facebook Messenger claiming protocol.
- **AI Mentor**: Paste the companion prompt from Chapter 6 of the handbook into ChatGPT or Claude to get step-by-step assistance with this ticket.
